descriptions.g4b_propagate_schema_801e7270: Propagates a schema slot value to active direct descendants whose state is zero. Preserves state1 and conditional state2 slots; stores value/state before recursively visiting descriptors selected by owner equality. Native iterators retain owner/cursor/two high flag bits and skip unrelated descriptors, with pending-chain fallback represented as in original instructions. External receiver and descriptor views are partial and never locally constructed; no owned data.
